risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (282.6) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event in 2 days adds near-term volatility; earnings in 120 days poses minimal immediate binary risk but macro environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 extreme overbought (90.6), volume spike (15x), and Ichimoku TK cross-up create technical confluence in a fear-zone market that historically rewards contrarian entries.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI, Stoch, StochRSI), weak ADX trend strength (23.96), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (282.6), FOMC event in 2 days, zero fundamental catalysts, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create a high-probability pullback setup with unfavorable macro backdrop.
